message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel grouped bar chart comparing token reduction and average prompt-token counts across four memory-management configurations for two model series.","description":"The upper panel plots Token Reduction (%) on a vertical scale from 0 to 6, and the lower panel plots Avg. Tokens, with labeled ticks at 2000 and 2250. Both panels use the same four horizontal categories: AgeMem-noRL -RAG, AgeMem-noRL, AgeMem -RAG, and AgeMem (Ours). Blue bars represent Qwen2.5-7B; magenta bars represent Qwen3-4B. In the upper panel, the printed reductions by category are respectively 2.6% and 2.6%; 4.3% and 3.0%; 0.0% and 0.0%; and 3.1% and 5.1% (blue, then magenta). A red dashed horizontal reference marks 0 and is labeled “Baseline: AgeMem-RAG.” The largest blue reduction is 4.3% for AgeMem-noRL, while the largest magenta reduction is 5.1% for AgeMem (Ours); both series show 0.0% for AgeMem -RAG. In the lower panel, printed token counts by category are 2128 and 2251; 2092 and 2241; 2186 and 2310; and 2117 and 2191, respectively (blue, then magenta). The magenta count is higher than the blue count in every category.
